title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 442 Miller Valley Road in Prescott, Arizona, as the "Barry M. Goldwater Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 442 Miller Valley Road in Prescott, Arizona, as the "Barry M. Goldwater Post Office."

summary.headline: Congress named a Prescott, Arizona post office after former senator Barry Goldwater.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 442 Miller Valley Road in Prescott, Arizona, as the "Barry M. Goldwater Post Office." It is a naming change only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or its staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 18, 2014.
